# Self-concern and C under the condition

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide from every standpoint exactly where each marking is total: as a center's reach, where the root's condition holds; held de se, where the continuation condition does. There, admission decided, it ranks extensions between listed paths, one way.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. On a listing, every order is increasing in its own continuation exactly when it is increasing in admission if and only if the marking marks every listed item: a listed item left unmarked gives a self-concerned order not increasing in admission. Read from standpoints, for any relation the markings read, the two coincide everywhere exactly where it holds of every standpoint and item. (`Becoming.Weighting.exists_increasingInOwn_not_increasing`, `Becoming.Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_marks`, `Becoming.Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_all`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* widening; its declarations do not reach the grammar.
2. With each marking reading what the line under a class from the standpoint's center reaches along a relation, the two coincide everywhere exactly where the condition on the root holds; with it reading the center's closure along a relation, exactly where the condition held de se does. Near-definitional: the schema above at those readings. One half each: where it holds they coincide; an item outside parts them. (`Becoming.Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_noOutside`, `Becoming.Weighting.exists_increasingInOwn_not_increasing_of_outside`, `Becoming.Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_noOutside`, `Becoming.Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_unrestricted`, `Becoming.Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure and widening; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. With admission decided and what two level paths admit listed, an order increasing in admission ranks every extension between them, every claim counted as living; where the de se condition holds, so does an order increasing in the own continuation, each item marked by its formation. Listed paths admit nothing from some step on, and once there is a formation no list holds what every level path admits. (`Becoming.Web.admits_need`, `Becoming.Web.admits_nothing_from_of_listed`, `Becoming.Web.not_listsAdmitted_every`, `Becoming.Web.no_extension_of_listsAdmitted_every`, `Becoming.Web.extension_ranked_of_increasing`, `Becoming.Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure and widening; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
4. Along the net, self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide on the endless line of descent from its first birth, every later member failing the condition, and part on two family lines with no condition between them, whose first birth reaches exactly its own family; along the net's converse they coincide in descent that ends, from its last occurrence, and part on the endless line from every center. (`Becoming.TwoLines.first_line_reaches_both`, `Becoming.TwoLines.first_line_reach_iff`, `Becoming.increasingInOwn_with_net`, `Becoming.increasingInOwn_with_net_converse`, `Becoming.LineOfDescent.Endless.later_outside`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* widening; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. A finite listing; two-valued admission; an order a relation on courses, not assumed complete or transitive; each standpoint's marking supplied, read as each law states (where a law uses one half of a reading, only that half).
- Self-concern (Weighting.IncreasingInOwn) and the condition, on the root («续无外») or held de se (Unrestricted of the own closure), are hypotheses: neither is asserted, and the condition varies with the net, the class and the direction.
- For the ranking on a web: admission decided by a supplied two-valued reading, what both level paths admit listed as (step, formation) items, every claim counted as living, each item marked by the marking of its formation.
- The ethics rests on two premises with two roles: the continuation condition for scope and C (Comparison) for order. A ranking of courses still needs C or a premise in its place; this result locates where self-concern gives what C asks, one way: between two listed level paths, courses whose admissions end, where the de se condition holds and admission is decided.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That C follows from self-concern on all of a web's level paths: the link holds between two listed paths, courses whose admissions end. Witness: `Becoming.Web.not_listsAdmitted_every`.
- The converse, that C on level paths makes an order increasing in admission on a listing: a course on a listing need not be what any level path admits.
- That self-concern fails to rank an extension on a web where the condition fails: that half is proved on listings only.
- Any property of reach: the joins to the root are near-definitional, and locate where the two coincide.
- That the condition holds, that self-concern is warranted, or that C is derived: the condition and C stay the ethics' premises and self-concern a hypothesis; C's warrant is open.

**Standard boundaries:** States how significance relates to structure, for any significance or under the continuation condition (Unrestricted: the continuation of anything has significance); it asserts no significance and does not assert the condition. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · A conditional law does not make its antecedent universal; a theorem's premise is not thereby necessary for every achievement. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Self-concern is an order increasing in what one's own continuation marks; being increasing in admission is a Pareto-style monotonicity that gives what C asks between listed level paths (one way). Where one's own continuation marks everything, the two coincide, so there self-concern gives what C asks between listed level paths, one way; on all of a web's level paths it gives nothing this way. The reading of where that holds, the condition on the root, is near-definitional and claims no property of reach.
